title: 1RB1LB_1LC0RD_0LE1LA_0RF1RA_1LE0LA_---0RB: the right end is a closed 12-entry cycle
text: Each cell is rewritten from cells to its right, so a tape suffix is a closed system driven only by when the sweep enters it. The last 100 cells close in 12 windows forming one cycle; the real run follows it from round trip 2,112 on (496 changes up to 3·10<sup>6</sup> trips). The right end can only halt if a lone 1 forms in the bulk.
